name: Enomenaki
source:
Alicetella wakes up in an unfamiliar mansion and is reunited with a familiar boy, Over.

Without knowing what's going on, they wander around the eerie mansion...

...She... didn't know yet.

About the hopeless events that happened in that mansion—

[Translated from [url=https://romankessha.wixsite.com/romankessha]official website[/url]]
translation:
Alicetella在一座陌生宅邸中醒来，随后与熟悉的男孩Over重逢。

两人还不知道发生了什么，只能在阴森的宅邸里四处徘徊……

……她……还不知道。

那座宅邸中发生了令人绝望的事情——

[译自[url=https://romankessha.wixsite.com/romankessha]官方网站[/url]]
